- [FACT] The user is looking for meal prep ideas for the week.

- [EVENT] The user recently tried a recipe for Korean bibimbap from a cooking class's online recipe library and found it amazing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bibimbap is described as a delicious and nutritious meal.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Meal prep is a great way to save time, reduce food waste, and ensure healthy meals throughout the week.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested meal prep containers include:
  1. Glass containers with airtight lids (brands: Pyrex, Anchor Hocking, OXO).
  2. Stainless steel containers (brands: LunchBots, S'well, Klean Kanteen).
  3. BPA-free plastic containers (brands: Rubbermaid, Glad, Ziploc).
  4. Mason jars for salads, soups, or overnight oats.
  5. Reusable silicone bags (brands: Stasher, Silipint).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing meal prep containers include size, material, airtight seal, and insulation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested meal prep ideas include:
  - Grilled chicken or salmon with roasted vegetables.
  - Quinoa or brown rice bowls with roasted vegetables and protein.
  - Lentil or vegetable soups with crusty bread.
  - Overnight oats or chia seed pudding with fresh fruits and nuts.
  - Stir-fries with favorite protein and mixed vegetables.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended to label and date containers for food storage.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is thinking of doing a stir-fry with chicken and mixed veggies this week.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested marinades for chicken stir-fry include:
  1. Soy Sauce and Ginger: 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1-inch grated ginger, 1 tablespoon honey.
  2. Korean-Style Gochujang: 1/2 cup gochujang, 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar.
  3. Lime and Cilantro: 1/2 cup lime juice, 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1/4 cup chopped cilantro, 1 teaspoon ground cumin.
  4. Simple Sesame: 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tablespoon sesame oil,
